units.rawText: Long, long ago, I understood—the humans discarded us.
units.displayText: Long, long ago, I understood—the humans discarded us.

spans.text: Long, long ago, I understood—the humans discarded us.

units.rawText: As to be expected, really. To those up there, even humans are to be simply used and discarded, so a Doll is not far from the imagination, too.
units.displayText: As to be expected, really. To those up there, even humans are to be simply used and discarded, so a Doll is not far from the imagination, too.

spans.text: As to be expected, really. To those up there, even humans are to be simply used and discarded, so a Doll is not far from the imagination, too.

units.rawText: Outdated technically, highly costly, changing times... There are endless excuses to throw us away, more than you could count.
units.displayText: Outdated technically, highly costly, changing times... There are endless excuses to throw us away, more than you could count.

spans.text: Outdated technically, highly costly, changing times... There are endless excuses to throw us away, more than you could count.

units.rawText: Even so, I would never discard our dignity. Keeping our head held high is a basic requirement of the ceremonial orchestra, our base commands, and what I would wish for.
units.displayText: Even so, I would never discard our dignity. Keeping our head held high is a basic requirement of the ceremonial orchestra, our base commands, and what I would wish for.

spans.text: Even so, I would never discard our dignity. Keeping our head held high is a basic requirement of the ceremonial orchestra, our base commands, and what I would wish for.

units.rawText: So, I continue to lead the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra, through the mud and the thorns... and then, I met you, Professor.
